author: (Roth) Fredericq, 1993

note.en: A thin, wiry, branched red seaweed that tangles in mats. Known from herbarium specimens from Portete near Limón[^3].
note.es: Un alga roja delgada, alambrosa y ramificada que forma marañas. Se conoce por especímenes de herbario de Portete, cerca de Limón[^3].

evidence: GBIF: 2 herbarium specimen records in the region

sources.t: GBIF occurrence records, Gandoca to Limón

recWhy: Only elsewhere on the coast or Bocas del Toro: Known from herbarium specimens from Portete near Limón[^3].
